comment: The set's cover (issue #114), written by `packbuilder cover` or `packbuilder build` and by `packbuilder cover-review`; review on build/pack-art/<pack id>/cover.jpg. The edition theme, workflow, prompts version and model the round was painted with, each candidate's seed and SHA-256 (the cover cache's file name), and the review: pending, approved (candidate `chosen`, numbered from 1 as on the sheet, ships; `thumbnail` is the index's copy beside this file) or rejected (a new round of seeds next run).
theme: fog rolling over the bay, oak hills and redwoods in cool silver light
